items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Then all of a sudden Arthur Godfrey came on television about 1947, ‘48, teaching ukulele. And I got smitten, seriously smitten with the [scats] beautiful sound of the strings

ctx.x: No kidding. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -3-

No. I played piano at Peabody. And I was six years old, and I studied there, this was in 1946. My mother used to send me downtown on the bus by myself. It was perfectly safe. There was a statue in downtown Baltimore of a guy riding a horse, an English guy riding a horse with his arm out like this. My mother said, “When you see the horse and the guy pointing, Peabody’s right — he’s pointing right at Peabody. Get off the next block.” I did. It was fine. The only trouble was is I, for whatever reason, didn’t like to…
